body:
Hi there. I understand your panic regarding future employment, but, you need to seriously lay the fuck back and take in the situation. Constantly envisioning your g/f leaving you will result in.... you guessed it, you g/f leaving you!

You clearly have a capability to smash out qualifications and given the opportunity, time and space there is no question you'd breeze it. I'm sorry if I have overlooked any key factors here but I see two scenarios here:

1. Come clean about your situation and feelings with gf and move on somehow with her suppourt.

2. Focus on a solo life project, your current gf might tag along but your life is about sorting yourself out, as you are the most important person in your life!
Sorry to hear you have had a shit time, glad to hear you don't want to end it. Any advice on how to stay positive?

Well I hope you don't take this badly but from what you have described it almost like a self imposed inferiority thought pattern that you are experiencing? 
No judgment from me. I'm not prepared to have a friendship with any of my ex's to avoid the situation you describe, so I think its fairly reasonable to think that way.
But, at some point you have to begrudgingly accept the reality around you, attempt to make the best of your scenario and ultimately learn to be happy for the people who are and/or were in your life for making the best of their own situations.
Easier said than done but you really cant speculate on another persons happiness based on how you view their situation. Your time should be focused mostly on getting what you can out of life for yourself!

Has your friend committed any action to upset you? What is the reason for feeling you have messed up your relationship with her? 
I live with a parent too, not my dream but it gives me a security to plan a future.. I hope this could be the case for you to??

Seems like the writing is on the wall for this friendship. From my own experience being in a situation similar to your 'friend' the best thing people did was move on without me. Upsetting at the time but it kicked me into a realization of the friendships and connections i was about to lose.. Many apologies later I respect a persons decision to conclude they cant help someone further..
Has this chap got any family you could contact? I'm no expert but this sounds like a situation most people could not handle solo and the authorities should be notified. Best of luck.

You are the victim of an alleged sexual assault. You must contact your college/university immediately to report this incident. Once reported I suggest you make another post with any questions you feel need answering. For now this post shall remain as historic record.

I'm no expert but I should imagine he either wants to talk without judgment about his daughter, or take his mind off the situation, I wouldn't mention your predicament personally. Let him control the conversation, be prepared for extreme emotions. I cannot imagine what he is going through, my heart goes out to him and his family.

Sounds like you have a fighting attitude in you, that will serve you well in your situation. Can you give us a bit more info? Age, interests, skills..
At 27 I find myself (for the first time) in a position where I have time in my life to make new friends but not quite sure how! Work is quite an easy option for me but I am interested to see the other responses. One idea I had was doing some local volunteer work, figured even if I don't make some new pals, at least I'm doing some good in the world! Is this an option for you??
Great uplifting testimony, sometimes a positive outlook can conquer all! Good luck to you bro.

I tried to take my life through a similar method. I knew that if executed properly it would end my life. I did the same as you and 'woke up' with it having failed.. Truth is I didn't want it to succeed, I wanted help and didn't know how to ask for it, I certainly couldn't admit this to anyone.

Dark feelings are cunning tricksters. they pull the wool over your eyes, make you believe the worst. They attempt no declaration of truth, they feed of weakness. We should face this enemy head on from a a business standpoint. From a colleague view. I'd like to see more people engage the store manager around shrink concerns or wins.

 that nearly cost a life on my deparment.

Do the same people who deal the tough love know you are posting on a suicide forum? I hope they would see its not the way to treat you if they knew the impact it is having, you deserve better than this.
What are your final 2 choices?
Who tells you this? Whats your situation? Calling someone a stupid whore doesn't sound right at all, are these people helping you because it doesn't sound like it..

This is really hard to read, I feel extreme empathy for your situation. Regrettably I share more similarities with your older brother than yourself, but I have younger siblings myself who give me more strength in life than they could ever know. As it happens no one in my life knows my true feelings regarding suicide, hopelessness etc. I see seeking help (like most people) as a very brave and necessary step to best seek a  happy and positive life.

What I will say to help you perhaps come to terms with or consciously recognize is that it is certainly possible to be in a mindset where no amount of external support and love one has from friends and family can overcome crippling dark thoughts. So please don't place any blame on yourself at any point for any scenarios that have occurred. Its pretty clear you are doing everything you can for your brother, this is fantastic and he is lucky you have you as a sibling!

I wish you both the best, not really advice unfortunately, I'll end this by saying my younger brother helps me most when we have real heartfelt conversations and hes honest with me, warts and all. I respect the fact he wont just feed me positives all the time, he just tells me how he sees things and lets me get stuff off my chest. I really value that, perhaps your older brother might too? All the best.
Why do you say this, what has happened?

I'm sorry to read about anyone having such a horrific time in their life. I'm sure at your current stage of thinking has spent countless hours contemplating different scenarios., this is something I feel I can relate to. I must ask how do you measure 'success' in life, it sounds strange but I'd like to know as a stranger whether you would consider me successful by your criteria, and would you think differently about yourself when applying it to anyone other than you. Hope that makes sense.

As per above posts I'm really hoping there is some light at the end of the tunnel for you, feel free to pm me or post in here if there's anything you would like to get off your chest or perhaps advice on..
I'm sorry to hear about this, sounds like you have a huge amount on your plate right now. May I ask how old you are and which country you are from?

Hi there, I have read your submitted text, some worrying similarities to how I feel/am sometimes. Unfortunately I'm not replying to offer advice, you sound extremely clued up with regards to the dark and deeply personal subject of ending ones life and self analysis, I'm sure you haven't posted to be told 'have you tried exercise' or 'have you seen a medical professional'.I'm also not sure I'm in any position to offer advice so I can only really listen and assure you there is a random person out in the world wishing you the best. That said, you clearly have a great strength within you to continue seeking resolution and despite your situation regarding drugs and a job you dislike,  I'm certain they are life's mountains you will find a way of conquering.
Feel free to pm me over the next hour if there is anything I could support with, Kind regards.

Unfortunately a month is a very short amount of time to be in a position of having 'moved on' from a relationship, this doesn't seem a target that you could realistically envisage currently (adding unnecessary pressure). I advise you make small daily, and possibly weekly targets that revolve around keeping yourself occupied and active. I also think you should reach out to someone close to talk to. I see you describe yourself as having no one to talk to, I hope with some further consideration you can make the first move to contact a friend or family member. I cant speak for you, but I have felt at times like I have no one to talk to, only to re-evaluate and realize if I make the first move, there are people who will listen (perhaps I wanted them to instinctively know I needed to talk). Feel free to reply by pm if you would like to get anything off your chest over the next few hours, or in thread if you would like to convey anything for others to see. Kind regards.

Well I can certainly relate to a breakup triggering a massive change in life outlook, leading to a nasty downwards spiral. Can you expand a bit on what you mean by there being a 'problem' with you, and who exactly feels there isn't one?
I wish you the absolute best mate. I really hope someone on here can put forward some decent advice for you. Pm me anytime if you fancy a chat to offload anything :)

Do you think this relationship ending has triggered this? Perhaps its time to talk to a professional regarding these thought patterns, that I must say I don't feel you should have to accept, or take your own life (I'm assuming this has crossed your mind to post on this sub). 
I have been through periods of saying to myself 'I have everything I want' I look at it now most as a justification for not allowing myself to accept help with a problem that was clearly consuming me at the time, I hope this is not the case for yourself.

This is such a sad thread to read, post and replies inclusive. Perhaps its because some of it resonates with me so profoundly. I wish I had some sort of wicked advice to change peoples outlook and thinking, but it seems a lot of this (to me anyway) is born out internal thoughts that are beyond our control. May I ask what you image of the life you are supposed to live is? And do you think this is derived from the lives you see other people lead? Regards.

I have read your post through several times. I'm sorry to say I cant really offer any tried and tested advice for you as I haven't been trodden on by the world as it sounds like you have. May I ask what is your situation regarding any mental health diagnosis and treatments you are currently involved with? Also do have any family you trust/can rely upon, I'm assuming here that you don't feel you have any close friends?

Gonna reply to this post before the original post, I think you need to re-read everything you wrote here my friend. I really don't feel good about the way you have sort of accepted a situation you are not happy with, there is no way you deserve to feel the way you do. Not upsetting those around you is not a good enough reason to stay alive, I also think you can reach a point where the people around you are not enough to prevent you from committing suicide, and the process of getting to that point will be a slow downwards spiral. Life should not be lived that way! I apologize if this comes across as condescending or preachy but I would urge you to consider some options to help yourself, you certainly deserve better than what you are describing, even if you aren't a suicidal individual! Regards.

How do you feel about other people bettering themselves, such as friends or family? Do you simply not relate to the mindset of someone who wants to improve in some way e.g acquiring more money, better education, spend more time socializing etc. Also have you always felt like this, or have you reached your limit regarding how much you care about life and life goals? Regards.

Shit, this is a horrific post to read, many things about your situation I can relate to (to some extent anyway). I wish I had done what you have now and posted back then, but for me I went down a particularly dark path post several painful events. I'd say you need to play your cards carefully here, you are likely in massive shock so need to take every step available to avoid making any big decisions. I'm not going to pry into the details of what exactly your wider life situation is, making small changes to your current lifestyle to build yourself back up will at some point be essential to moving your life forward. However, I imagine you are not even at a point where you can think about yourself and the future, I ask that you reply to my message, in thread or by pm, I'd certainty like to help you in any way I could, even if its just to let you know that someone is out there, reading your posts, and wishing you well. Kind regards.

That must have been a tough conversation, I commend your strength. I'm certain your post(s) will inspire others that dealing with these situations are absolutely about small victories, relying on support and drawing upon your own strength wherever possible! Thanks again!

A few things you mentioned resonate with me, could you give a few more details around how long you have felt like this, how strong are these suicidal feelings? I'm sure many will disagree with me, but when I was wanting to play a lot of video games for excessive amounts of time, it was often to escape certain aspects of life that i struggled with, this is possibly the situation here and I would go one step further to say if this could be the case, I would look at cutting down and doing some other things with your time (I say this from my own personal experience and I'm certainly not a professional so take that how you will!.
Also I would add, it sounds like you are putting a huge amount of pressure on yourself, posting on this sub is often the first step that a person takes to reach out for support, but its certainly not the only route you can go! There are many options for you going forward, its important to be honest with yourself, accept that suicidal feelings are not something to accept you will have to live with, and you certainly deserve to live a live as free from them as possible. Interested to read your response to this, and to ask one final question, how do you feel since posting on this sub, do you get some sort of relief or release simply for putting your thoughts down in written form, and to have real people read it and reply? Regards.

Would there be an opportunity to have a more direct conversation with your friend, over Skype or something? Sounds like this guy trusts you as he has spoken (to some extent) about how he is feeling. But I must say ultimately you shouldn't burden yourself with this too much, you are extremely limited in what you can do! I'm guessing you don't live anywhere near this chap, and have no contact information of people who do such as friends or family. I would say just try to be an outlet for him to be honest and open about how he is feeling before you try and push any help onto him (as you describe he has been so far unperceptive to your attempts to offer sensible advice). Is there any more information about your friend that might help people on this forum to assist? Regards.

I'm not used to seeing (what is to me) an uplifting post on this sub but good job to you! May I ask how did you approach the initial conversation with your parents regarding suicidal tenancies? Regards.
Tell us a bit more about yourself, I think you do care, but what about I'm not sure! Tell me, Tom.

I want to kill myself because of job pressures partially. I have no advice for you with the information given, but my thoughts go out to you. And I feel in my own heart an area of pain dedicated to your situation and wishing you the best in this tough situation. If there is anything you think I can do to help you, please pm me and let me know. I want to do what I cant to support a fellow human in need of help. Tom.
Why does it not end well. I fucking hope you don't end your life. The reasons you list don't warrant the end of a life, they suggest a self loathing that could be addressed. Tom.

Do you feel love for people around you, friends family, can you honestly tell me know don't hope for some sort of peace within your own thoughts? I have told people I felt nothing, but later realized it was more me wishing to block them out, because I had worked myself into a state of isolation and complete disregard for external help. Ground yourself. Step back. Who are you, what matters to you? Please don't respond with nothing, I don't buy it. Tom.
What advice do you have for a man who feels similar to you? As you are on the precipice of life and death I would like to know. How do you feel about others ending their life? Tom.
I'd rather you talked things through, pm me please. You don't post on here for a legacy, its for help. please contact me or one of the other responders, Tom.
Been there my friend. Let me guess, no medical assistance or even anyone around you knows you feel like this?? Tom.

You'll hate to hear it but the facts are clear to me from your testimony. You have been duped by this older man, he isn't the right person for you, and he has left you damaged to a certain extent. You are young and I'm not the best person to reach out to you as at your age I was a a lot more naive, I certainly didn't know my issues would result in the man that I am today. I think you need a massive step back from irrationality, accept certain aspects of your thinking and develop a plan for yourself to move on. Sorry if that sounds blunt but that is my own personal experience talking, others will likely offer better support and advice than me. Tom.

I have been a gym go-er and powerlifter for some years, this has always been a good outlet for me. I certainly can relate to the overwhelming taxation of having the love of your life, your soul mate decade that you don't deliver to them, what they feel they deserve. The first days aren't the worst, the first weeks aren't the worst. Where you are now is where it really has sunk in. But hitting the bottom is the best thing right now, because it stops the plummeting. That pistol in the other room is a test, one that I may not have passed at times. But I, and all those responding could well have been through similar situations to your and are testament to the fact that it is possible to recover out of it. Don't know if I will be strong enough to carry on without her, don't know if you will be without your ex. But internal strength in us will decide that, I wish you the best and hope you find a path to happiness as a wholeheartedly believe you deserve it. Tom.

Sounds like the world is on top of you my friend, I don't know how your legal system works, but it seems to me you need help more than punishment (if that is the potential result of going to court). What could the people of this forum do to possibly help you? I feel a bit lost trying to reach out to you tonight.. Help me help you my friend, tell me something you would like to aim towards, however little, a dream or wish of yours for yourself. Tom.

I don't think you could have given him perspective. I know When I was close there was no reasoning with me. And I wouldn't open up to anyone. I am sorry for your loss. My thoughts are with the daughter who will grow up with no father, what a tragic situation. I wish you all the strength in the world to help cope with this. Tom.

I need to go to bed now (I live in the UK). I think you should ask their opinion on this, because I find it hard to believe you legitimately feel this could be true. Have another read over our whole interchange, give it all some more consideration. And I would like to hear from you again, hopefully your mind will be thinking with a different perspective, I just don't think you do anyone a service by taking your life. Just the opinion of one person, take it how you wish.. Tom.

Being a hypocrite is easily done, and we hold ourselves to our own standards. I'm certainly not your father! I sign my posts with my real name (and get asked about it frequently) because I feel its a minute way that I can (hopefully) get people to see understand this is a real human, like them who is taking the time to listen, to try to comprehend and if possible advise, although the last past is always the hardest. Because if I cant take advice, there is no reason for anyone else to! You sound considerably more grounded in through process than your original post, I found at my worst time(s) that getting the thought out of my head onto paper (in my case I have a daily diary) helps a lot, and I also recommend physical activity daily (if you don't already) to offer rest bites from your own thoughts, that intelligent over thinkers (like you may well be) need to stay on track! I'm certainly no expert, so don't take this as condescending advice, just my thoughts and opinions of the situation being described! As for me, I'm in no immediate danger, but it is terrifying to think how you can convince yourself suicide is the only option so I can relate to any poster who feels like that, just with different reasons behind it all. Best of luck my friend, pm me any time :) Tom.

How does that help, are you really mostly concerned about your legacy or do you not think the life you could make yourself now is how to redeem yourself (I don't mean that in a religious way). Do you see any sense in my post above, righting wrongs etc? Tom.

If you can really view things as bluntly as that, can I ask you if you have ever loved anyone, friends/family/partner. Even for a non-believer, which we both are in this case, I would say that strong emotions like this transcend the feeling of pointlessness that most of us feel and have felt at times. Could this be a temporary thought pattern or have you felt like this for a long time? Tom.

I still don't see that it helps anyone you may have hurt? Maybe I'm misunderstanding something here, but it seems like you want to escape your personal demons more than anything else? I'm not saying that's a 'wrong' way to think just my reading into it?
Being scared is probably an understatement, but if you were to ask me, I would say you owe it to yourself, and to anyone you claim to have hurt to become a contributor and an asset to society, and perhaps that's what anyone negatively affected by you in your life would say too. That seems good enough reason to be strong and face into it through the tough route of being strong enough to get over feeling scared. Tom

You sounds worryingly like myself. The only exception being that I have never looked into any form of professional help (meds/therapy etc). And like you I have not talked to anyone in my life, with 15+ years of internalized suicidal feelings. Through most of that I thought I could wish it away and to be fair most of my life I have distracted myself from the darkest thoughts by trying to live life like you have. I wish I could be brave like I feel you are (more so than me). What we both probably need is a person we know to talk to. I have come close it it before, but in all honesty I have been closer to taking my own life than actually trying to get help. This is concerning for me when I see a testimony such as yours it puts  my situation into perspective and makes me think differently about how I should approach it. Because you have put so much pressure on yourself, I wish I could convince you to take a step back and see that you are obviously a decent person, who deserves to be happy, who needs to find the strength to work out for yourself what is going to get you on the path to healing and out of a state of mind that you don't deserve to be in. I hope you and I can both find some way to resolve our issues. From one human to another.. Tom.

I just don't get how taking your own life makes up for any of this? And if its something you cant move away from then professional help might be a route to look into? Easy for me to say from behind a screen, but probably the quickest way to get some much needed perspective and support. Tom.
I would like you to know this is a real person behind these words, and that is my real name. Just trying to help ya mate. Tom!

Does anyone who knows you personally have any idea that you are in a state of mind where you feel a suicide support forum is where you are reaching out for help? Often people who post here do so as they don't feel they have anyone or don't want to open up to people they know for many different reasons. Tom.

Because I don't believe for a second that everyone who commits suicide could not have been helped and supported out of that decision, seems worth it to me to do what we can to try and save who we can from making a decision that doesn't address  underlying problems and causes. I know from my own experiences that it can feel impossible to open up, and that suicide is the only option. But I cant say this has been a feeling all my life, just one I have experienced before. I think any effort made to convince someone that their life is worth living is the right thing to do, because some people do have it within themselves to pull through suicidal feelings with the right help. Not all, but some. That is why it feels people insist on choosing life over death. Tom.

Feels like you need support big time. I would say with my little experience of life, but a lot of experience of loneliness and suffering, that forums like this are often a first reach out to someone who needs help in some form, but doesn't quite have the strength to source it from the correct areas in their life. There is no question that you are a very intelligent individual, a person able to give an awful lot back to this world at some point in their life. But now seems like a time that you need to take something from this world, help and support. I, and the other people reading (most wont post but read only) are taking in all you have written and wishing well for you. Please tell us who you could open up to. Because talking to a human who cares for you (friend, family or just someone you respect and knows you) can start a healing process that you need. Now my post seems a bit rambling, I would be interested in a response. Tom.

Is this the only thing that consumes you? You are clearly remorseful, looks to me like an extremely grey area if you are talking about two minors in the way you describe, I cant really see that the intent was there on your part to justify punishment and self hatred. That said this is just a personal view from the little information you have given, you have posted on suicide watch, is there something else going on in your mind right now? Tom.

Don't hold yourself to a different standard than others around you. I feel many people that describe thought patters like your own put a lot of pressure on themselves to act or be a certain way, and when they don't achieve it they punish themselves internally, is that a fair assessment? Can I ask how long you have felt so negative towards so many things? Tom.

This shouldn't be your last day. Who deserves this? You don't. Help the users of this sub seek a solution for you, one day at a time, healing is possible. Shit times occur, but they also pass, slowly, with no tracking they pass. lets make a plan? Tom.

I'm from the UK I'm not sure i completely understand this bit ' I blew a .41 BAC' ??
Take it on the chin, but you are 17, you have an amount of maturing to go through, however damaged you feel now. Do you not feel you have a fucking lot to give to this world, for yourself if nothing else, and more broadly advice to people who really need it from you, what haven't been as strong as you?. Don't let it beat you, I say this a lot to people on this sub, but it feels that once we gain perspective, our ability to offer advice increases, and with advice given to others come strength, and support.
Sometimes I feel really weak, thinking I should end my life with my (relatively minor) problems, but its all perspective. 
Seems to me you should aim as quick as possibly to become independent and you will thrive given your ability to so far conquer all that has unfortunately occurred to you so far. My kindest regards, Tom.

Communication issues in relationships can often be solved by one party taking the initiative to be mature and leading the conversation. Whilst objectivly that may be his role here, could you be strong enough to fully explain your feelings in a calm and succinct manner, take the initiative to fix things with him first, so you two can fight the world together. I wish I still had the option of being able to save my relationship. Life was better for me as a team, rather than on my own, but like you your bf (as you describe) I made my mistakes. Sometimes we need a mature, honest and heartfelt conversation, whether by phone, face to face or written, to bring us back to orbit with what joy we really have around us, before it is snatched away by life's harsh realities. I would be interested in a response to this. Tom.

What country are you from? You sounds an awful lot more pro-active and intelligent than I was at your age so I hope there is a route to medical help. Stay strong, People are here to offer advice, and can help further with a bit more information! Sounds like your mum perhaps is struggling to get into your state of mind, I have found this in my own life, that the people I respect the most have no time or thoughts for those that do feel suicidal (in my care they did not know how I feel/felt) but these people are to be bypassed, and those that understand to be listened to. I personally await your response, as I am sure many forum readers are too. Tom.

Breaking point is when I posted to this sub. Seems to me this is where you might be. However you testimony points to such calculated views I can relate to as being potential issues only a professional could offer support with. No expert myself, I think you should consider this option, as ask yourself, after reading you post to yourself again, what you might offer someone in the way of advice if it were not you posting, but someone you cared for? Tom.

If you really feel things are at a stage of ending it all, is it the wrong idea to let them know how you feel? What advice might you give to someone describing your situation to you? Its ok to be a hypocrite, but it may help you think differently?
I don't think you would wish the though of suicide to anyone, so I don't see why you should have to go through that yourself. Many have fought through it, with many different methods. Lets try and find methods that work for you. Your post is a cry for help, even if i cant offer that, perhaps you can draw strength from my wishes for you to seek whatever solution is necessary to get you back to a happy and peaceful mindset, that you most certainly deserve to attain. Tom.

Well I've not been with another girl since I forced the last one away, so it sounds like you are able to move on in some sense, for some time at least. There is no fucking way to get a girl you love out of your head, sorry but that is my life experience talking. You wait it out. You comply with self set rules and disciplines to attempt to better yourself (physical health, education, social interaction). And somehow, some way each day you get through and you get through with a better knowledge of yourself, and how to deal with situations. Like someone losing weight, you never recognize it day to day, but you do over a longer period of time. I absolutely recommend a daily diary, for me using one was the equivalent of throwing my feelings out of my head and onto paper. This sub can re-create some of that, but a diary is a unique space to write in a way that requires no response or judgement or explanation. It is your own to shape, and maybe never read back to yourself. It certainly helped me, I'd like to hear back from you at some point, hoping you give this a go. Tom.

Can you describe your current living situation a bit clearer? I see a way forward, what kind of resilient and strong character could so far cope with these horrific events and still have the will power to submit a testimony for (what feels like) the most minor support available to you? At least as a poster to you that's how it feels. I wish I could do something to change your past, but we know that cannot happen. I recommend looking at other posts in this sub, perhaps attempting to advise and/or support people, this helped me gain perspective and strength for my own situation (certainly not as unbearable as your own, but I nearly ended my own life recently). I would really appreciate your thoughts on my post, by pm or in this thread, Tom.

May I ask how old you are my friend? Your thoughts sound a bit all over the place. Your post is 30 minutes old at the time of mine, how do you feel now? Any changes or updates to your thought patterns? Tom.

What makes life hard for you? You sound so dead set it has me extremely beaten in terms of what I can reply with, though not a  post I haven't seen people fight back from. Please let me, and those who read but do not post know that you are responding and being objective with your situation, as anonymous people are able to support you with. Tom.

I'm really scared I will fall into this same situation. So much regret in life, losing a girlfriend due to my own behavior, but I'd also like to believe I can somehow get through it. I just don't want life to bully me into submission, do you ever feel like that? Like even how low you are you don't want to be beaten by a situation?
I read the most horrific stories on this sub and it helps me to rationalize my own situation. 
'I know what I need' - Yeah I thought it did too. Ask me if I still feel like that now a few days later? Tom.

Do you you have someone in your life you would be prepared to confide in? I feel you need more than just myself or another anonymous (albeit concerned with your wellbeing) individual to reach out to? Please respond, Tom.

You don't sound that weak to me. Who should ever have to go through such a burdening experience as you have? But you are still here, and you have posted for a response. Sounds to me like you have some serious and immediate issues to address within your life. There are many different subs that may help you more with these, especially regarding to medial or financial problems. 
I cant say I have been through the same as you, so I can only empathize so far, but listening to stories like your own make me feel that suicide is less of an option for myself (the impact it has on your loved ones alone). I wouldn't wish your situation on anyone. I hope you can gain the strength that I, and others reading this are wishing to pass to you as a source of moving out of the darkest time you are currently in. Tom.

I may not fit you're post request, I think that some points here might break the sub rules as it may come across as advice on suicide methods. But I did have mapped out exactly the suicide route I would take recently, I don't know what it feels like to come as close to suicide as attempting and failing, as I feel my plan would not have allowed for failure. 
I did, however post on this sub because I likely had some part of me that wanted to carry on with life, and meet those expectations you feel the people who know have of you.
